title: Week 13 — Study Space Challenge practice
status: Draft practice questions; teacher review required
instructions: Public self-assessment based on this week's lesson; not a confidential FiiCode examination.

questions.prompt: What happens immediately after entering a room profile in k-NN?
options: A language model writes an essay
Distances to labelled training examples are computed
The validation set is permanently rewritten
questions.explanation: Distances make it possible to select neighbours.

questions.prompt: If k=3, how many labelled neighbours vote?
questions.explanation: The closest three training examples contribute votes.

questions.prompt: Why does the distance formula scale each feature?
options: To guarantee every prediction is correct
To compare measurements with different numeric ranges
questions.explanation: Features have different units and ranges.

questions.prompt: With scale 100 and weight 1, what is the squared-distance contribution of a 20-point occupancy difference?
What does this introductory k-NN model store?
options: Only a trained neural-network weight tensor
The final test answers as lookup rules
questions.explanation: This method compares new samples directly to stored labelled examples.

questions.prompt: Labels among nearest neighbours are good, good, avoid. What is the majority vote?
How should the Python interface handle Wi-Fi strength 8?
options: Accept it because numbers are valid
questions.explanation: Wi-Fi must be an integer between 1 and 5.

questions.prompt: Which is true if all three nearest neighbours vote good?
options: The votes support good but are not a calibrated probability
There is no chance of label noise
questions.explanation: A vote fraction is not automatically calibrated confidence.

questions.prompt: Select ALL good software engineering practices.
options: Validate inputs independently of UI widgets
Separate prediction logic from the interface
Hardcode the correct test labels inside the predictor
Hide the distance calculation from tests
questions.explanation: The model should be independently testable and the UI should enforce clear contracts.

questions.prompt: Select ALL factors needed to reproduce a k-NN result.
options: Fixed dataset split and feature values
Just a screenshot of the percentage
questions.explanation: Settings and data completely determine the deterministic classifier.
